description: Refactor step M4, class B (docs/plans/codebase-refactor.md §5.1, §6.5): cmd/server's main() becomes a sequence of stage calls, each stage a contiguous range of today's main() moved line for line into a method of app in a wire_<stage>.go file, called in today's order; the locals more than one stage uses become app's fields. Every defer stays in main(): signals returns stop and connect returns db.Close for main() to defer where it does today. Lines are cmd/server/main.go's as this spec was written; each range is found again by its first line's text when the file has moved on. Preview with: go run ./internal/tools/stageextract -n -spec internal/tools/stageextract/specs/M4.json
